Diamond & Pearl series · GE

Great Encounters

Released February 1, 2008 · 106 cards

Great Encounters is a Pokémon TCG expansion in the Diamond & Pearl series, released in English on February 1, 2008. It has 106 cards. It includes 100 Pokémon, 6 Trainer and 0 Energy cards, and is not legal in Standard or Expanded.

Illustrators

24 illustrators worked on Great Encounters. Most cards: Ken Sugimori (27), Daisuke Ito (12), Mitsuhiro Arita (8), Kagemaru Himeno (7), Masakazu Fukuda (7), Ryo Ueda (7), Kouki Saitou (6), Kent Kanetsuna (5).
